Question: Do State Farm Insurance agents have to maintain a template website?
Answer: I used to work for Allstate and State Farm was a major competitor. Most of the agents have their "own" website...Which is just a templated site created by StateFarm and hosted at the agents name (.com). This was a bad SEO strategy and State Farm was getting beat up in the local search landscape. Now, Google has decided that big brands are more trustworthy and its harder than ever to rank an independent agent above the likes of State Farm and Allstate...Even though their sites have boilerplate (duplicate) content, are one page, and are rarely optimized. This goes to show you how you can violate nearly every "law" of SEO and still rank well.
